description.content: API for managing part requisitions and production batches

Creates a new work order on the requisition and schedules the requested quantity into its first operation, distinct from the idempotent bulk schedule path. Uses the ad-hoc routing given by optional ordered operationIds, else the template given by optional routingTemplateId, else the spec's designated default template, else a system-derived routing. routingTemplateId alongside operationIds records which template the ad-hoc steps were customized from. Its routing can be diverged afterward via the routing editor.
